name: Craft Anything
tagline: Point at any website, app, or game, and a coding agent builds you a working copy from scratch.
sentence: Studies existing software - a website, an app, a game - and has a coding agent build a fresh version in your chosen language, then compares and refines it until it matches.

visual.alt: Craft Anything's Simple mode showing a completed snake game built from a text prompt, with a green snake on a dark grid and a score counter at the top.
visual.caption: Simple mode: describe what you want, and the agent builds it.

board.say: You see software you admire but can't build your own version of it.
You paste a URL or point it at an app and say 'Recreate this.'
A website URL, an app, a game, or a file you want to study and rebuild.
The app studies the target, has a coding agent build a new version, and refines it.
steps: Studies the target - takes screenshots at every width, reads visible text and layout
A coding agent (like Claude Code) builds a new project in your chosen language
Compares the build with the original and lists mismatches
Refines until the comparison check passes

board.say: A working project you own, built from scratch.

outputs.eg: Paste a website URL and get a working copy in your chosen language, checked against the original
The app found 2 mismatches (missing footer, wrong font) and fixed them in a second pass

before: You see a website or app you like and try to code something similar from scratch, guessing at behavior
Reverse engineering takes specialized tools and deep technical knowledge
after: Point at any software and get a working recreation in your chosen language, checked against the original
Clean-room mode means you work only from visible material - screenshots and text - not source code
uses_note: Craft Anything is 6 days old. No independent user reports have been published yet.

coverage.title: Open-source tool that studies software and builds fresh versions

steps: Download the installer for your OS from [GitHub Releases](https://github.com/storytold/craft-anything/releases/latest) (about 60 MB)
Open [Craft Anything](https://getartcraft.com/apps/craft-anything), paste a website URL, and say 'Recreate this website'
Review the comparison checks and approve the result, or request changes
try.paste:
/skillspector https://github.com/storytold/craft-anything
Then: Download from the Releases page, open the app, paste a simple website URL and say 'Recreate this website.' 10 minutes.

footprint.disk: About 60 MB for the app (Linux AppImage is 59.4 MB, deb is 64.2 MB).
footprint.runs_on: macOS, Windows, Linux, FreeBSD. Requires a coding agent installed (like Claude Code). Building from source needs Rust 1.97+.

best_for: Anyone who sees an app or website and wants their own version of it
People who want to learn how software works by rebuilding it
Non-coders who want a coding agent to do the building for them
skip_if: You need production-quality code - this is early alpha
You don't have a coding agent installed (Claude Code, Codex, or similar)
You want to copy source code directly - Craft Anything works from screenshots and visible text only

alternatives.name: Hallmark
alternatives.line: A design skill for web pages - focuses on making AI-built sites look hand-designed, not on recreating existing ones

alternatives.name: Unslop
alternatives.line: Fixes the generic look of AI-built interfaces pass by pass, rather than rebuilding from scratch

watch: **Early alpha.** The README says so explicitly - expect rough edges and incomplete features.
**Requires a coding agent.** Craft Anything doesn't write code itself. You need Claude Code, Codex, or a similar agent installed and signed in on your machine.
**Clean-room only.** It works from screenshots and visible text, not source code. Results may not replicate behavior exactly.
**Check your rights.** Only use it on software you own or are allowed to examine. Recreating copyrighted software may have legal implications.
